subject.title: feat(onboard): browser-first guided handoff (draft — held on fresh-gateway auth)

question: Should browser-first onboarding remain held until the fresh-gateway credential source is made identical to the running gateway’s authentication state?
rationale: Choosing between fixing the startup-to-handoff credential contract, temporarily making the feature opt-in, or accepting a known fallback on the primary fresh-install path changes the intended onboarding product behavior and upgrade contract.

options.title: Fix runtime credential handoff
options.body: Pass the gateway startup-owned target and resolved credential into the browser handoff, align the docs, and require successful fresh GUI and headless proof before merge.

options.title: Ship as explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep terminal onboarding as the default and expose browser handoff only through an experimental opt-in until fresh-gateway authentication is reliable.

options.title: Keep the phase held
options.body: Leave this PR in draft or close it while retaining the diagnosis in the onboarding redesign plan until the gateway-auth prerequisite has a separate proven fix.

recommendation.title: Fix runtime credential handoff
recommendation.body: Pass the gateway startup-owned target and resolved credential into the browser handoff, align the docs, and require successful fresh GUI and headless proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties the guided custodian flow and phase-3 onboarding direction most directly to this person.
